text: Perceive your attention as a manifestation of respect and love. By directing your full, undivided attention to a person or to some project, you give the most valuable resource—your presence. This strengthens relationships, improves the quality of any work, and is the highest form of ethics. The inability to concentrate is not simply a deficiency; it is a manifestation of disrespect for life. Because it is precisely your attention that animates that toward which you direct it. Lack of concentration can be compared to scattering seeds not onto fertile soil, but anywhere—on a windowsill, in a toilet, in a car. That is also how the focus of attention of many people darts about.
